rules.title: C: gets() has no bounds check
rules.message: gets() cannot limit how much it reads and overflows the buffer: use fgets

rules.title: C: strcpy() has no bounds check
rules.message: strcpy() does not check the destination size: use a bounded copy such as strncpy or snprintf

rules.title: C: strcat() has no bounds check
rules.message: strcat() does not check the destination size: use strncat with the remaining space

rules.title: C: sprintf() has no bounds check
rules.message: sprintf() does not check the buffer size: use snprintf

rules.title: C: system() runs a shell command
rules.message: system() runs a shell command: pass arguments to execv instead when any part comes from input

rules.title: C: scanf with an unbounded %s
rules.message: scanf with %s and no width overflows the buffer: give a width such as %31s

rules.title: C: rand() is not secure
rules.message: rand() is not safe for tokens, keys or passwords
